critic_notes.rationale: This is essentially a rank-multiplied double sort on two well-published anomalies (R&D-to-sales, Chan-Lakonishok-Sougiannis, and Sloan accruals) with no mechanism that is not already spanned by their separate main effects, so the "interaction" adds little beyond a composite of known signals.

The advertising-intensity-growth leg is a less-mined ingredient and the sign convention on NEG(Δwcap/at) is internally consistent with the accrual anomaly, though the second leg is basically balance-sheet Sloan and xad's sparse reporting will likely make coverage and portfolio composition unstable.

Zero-filling all non-goodwill-growers via INDICATOR creates a large point mass that will dominate the cross-sectional sort and portfolio breakpoints, and what remains is the standard accrual anomaly conditioned on M&A activity — a documented conditioning, not a new mechanism.

The denominator ADD(ABS(accruals),ABS(dp/at)) is dominated by depreciation intensity rather than "accrual noise," so the signal is effectively an intangibles-to-depreciation ratio with explosive values when the denominator is near zero, and the stated hypothesis does not match what is computed.

Smoothed R&D intensity interacted with accrual-volatility (an earnings-quality/idiosyncratic-risk proxy) is a coherent and directionally consistent construction, but it remains close to a composite of two known effects and the 5-period VOL plus xrd requirement will thin coverage materially.

Compustat recch/invch are signed as cash-flow sources (positive = receivables/inventory decrease), so NEG(recch+invch) rewards exactly the accrual buildup the hypothesis claims to penalize — a direct sign inconsistency — compounded by requiring xrd, xad, recch and invch jointly, which will leave very sparse coverage.

This is essentially cash-based operating profitability (Ball et al. 2016) with an R&D add-back and an accrual-magnitude penalty subtracted on an incommensurate scale, and the hypothesis's conditioning on "R&D-heavy firms" is not actually implemented anywhere in the expression — the R&D add-back only mechanically shifts the profitability level.

Replacing the cross-sectional R&D level with an own-history TS_RANK and pairing it with the change (rather than volatility) of the accrual wedge is a substantively different construction from the archived persistent-R&D signal, though the 5-period TS_RANK is coarse and the multiplicative rank form will concentrate identification in the joint-high corner.

Internally consistent and the accrual-trend leg is a genuine change from the archived one-period delta versions, but it sits in the same intangibles×accruals family that has already produced weak results and the product-of-ranks form leaves the short leg poorly differentiated for a negative-sign signal.

This is a cosmetic variant of the archived INTAN_DEMAND_WORKCAP_CASH_RELEASE (fmb_tstat 0.15) with intan/at swapped for a 3-period average of xrd/sale, leaving the failed working-capital leg and overall structure untouched.

A level-based goodwill × accrual-wedge interaction is a defensible departure from the archived double-delta goodwill signal and the sign logic is coherent, but it is close to a conditioned accrual anomaly and the at+gdwl denominator double-counts goodwill for no stated reason.

This is a mechanical recombination of the first leg of INTAN_DEMAND_WORKCAP_CASH_RELEASE with the second leg of INTAN_BUILD_CASH_VERIFIED, both of which already failed in the archive, and offers no new economic content.

The denominator's |cumulative accrual| term is tiny relative to total assets for most firms, so the signal collapses to a 3-year R&D-to-assets ratio — the well-documented R&D-intensity anomaly — and the stated conditioning mechanism will barely bind.

This is a cosmetic re-scaling of the archive's RND_CASH_VERIFIED_EXPENSE_WEDGE (identical second leg, R&D deflator swapped from sales to assets-plus-intangibles), and since Compustat intan already subsumes gdwl the MAX() is a no-op, leaving little substantive difference from an already-evaluated signal.

The depreciation add-back genuinely converts total accruals into a working-capital accrual proxy (ib−oancf+dp ≈ ΔWC), so the hypothesis and expression are consistent and the decomposition is a real economic refinement of the archive's goodwill-wedge result rather than a relabeling, though it remains a close cousin of GOODWILL_EARNINGS_CASH_WEDGE and inherits its weak Fama-MacBeth support.

With intan already including goodwill the MAX() is redundant, leaving a plain intangible-intensity × total-accruals product whose only change from already-tested archive variants is industry ranking — a cosmetic tweak on top of the standard accrual anomaly.

Multiplying signed revenue growth by a strictly positive R&D intensity makes the first leg non-monotone (declining-revenue, high-R&D firms are pushed to the bottom rank rather than the middle), and the receivables-absorption leg replicates the mechanism already tested and rejected in INTAN_DEMAND_WORKCAP_CASH_RELEASE plus the known receivables-accrual anomaly.

A coherent double-difference formulation whose sign logic matches the expression and which is structurally distinct from the level-based archive winner, though double-differencing is noisy and the second leg is close to the known change-in-accruals anomaly.

This is the same three ingredients as the archived RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED (industry-adjusted gross margin × R&D intensity × 3-period mean R&D-adjusted cash wedge) merely regrouped across the two RANK legs, which is a cosmetic re-parameterization rather than a new mechanism.

The myopia-plus-accrual-inflation story is coherent and the expression's sign convention correctly matches the negative expected sign, though it risks being driven mostly by the second leg, which the archive already shows to be the strong standalone predictor (RND_CASH_VERIFIED_EXPENSE_WEDGE, ls_talpha 4.13).

This is near-identical to the archived GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP and ACQUIRED_INTAN_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP — adding a small R&D term to the goodwill denominator and a 3-period smoothing of the same accrual leg — and it does nothing to address the archive's key diagnostic that those variants had strong alphas with essentially zero Fama-MacBeth slopes.

The organic-versus-acquired intangible contrast paired with persistent cash verification is economically sensible and not an exact archive duplicate, but xrd enters both legs with the same sign, so the composite may largely reload on plain R&D intensity rather than the intended organic/acquired distinction.

The expression is internally consistent with the stated negative sign and pairs two legs not previously combined, though the archive's change-on-change constructions (RND_RAMP_CASH_WEDGE_IMPROVE, INTAN_BUILD_CASH_VERIFIED) have been uniformly weak, so prior odds of success are modest.

This is INTAN_MOAT_ACCRUAL_TRAP with goodwill substituted for intangibles and the same depreciation-adjusted accrual leg already tested in GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP, and it inherits the archived version's construction flaw that IND_ADJ margins can be negative, so multiplying by gdwl/at makes the first leg non-monotone in the intended "acquired moat" concept.

This is an aggregation-only re-specification of the archive's RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED (same three legs, MIN instead of MUL), and min-of-ranks compresses the entire lower two-thirds of the distribution into a near-tied mass, so any change in results will be hard to attribute to the claimed "all three tests" economics rather than to sort degeneracy.

The second leg simplifies to (xrd − accrual)/(xrd + |accrual|), a bounded share measure that is a genuinely different normalization from the asset-scaled RND_CASH_VERIFIED_EXPENSE_WEDGE and sharper than RND_ACCRUAL_NOISE_SHARE because the numerator is signed, though it sits close enough to both archive signals that the incremental information may be small.

This is a lego-recombination of two already-tested archive legs (the R&D-cut leg from RND_CUT_ACCRUAL_INFLATION/DETERIORATION and the depreciation-adjusted accrual leg from GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP) with no new economic content beyond swapping which add-back defines the wedge, and the R&D-cut/high-accrual channel is already close to the classic accruals anomaly conditioned on investment cuts.

Internally inconsistent as a raw product: a high value arises equally from acquired-intangible-heavy firms with positive working-capital accruals *and* from organic-R&D-dominant firms with negative accruals, so the sign no longer identifies the hypothesized red flag, and the switch from ranks to raw is otherwise a cosmetic respecification of ACQUIRED_INTAN_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP.

A de-ranked restatement of GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP with no new mechanism, and because gdwl is zero for a large share of firms the raw product collapses to an exact tie at zero for much of the cross-section, making the sort and the FMB slope driven by a skewed minority of goodwill-heavy outliers rather than by the stated economics.

The accrual-measure non-articulation leg is a genuinely new construct in this archive with a coherent earnings-quality-uncertainty story and a natural positive-magnitude (hence unambiguous-sign) second leg, but be aware that balance-sheet/cash-flow accrual disagreement is mechanically generated by acquisitions and divestitures (Hribar-Collins), so a negative result may just be re-expressing the known acquirer-underperformance effect and should be diagnosed against a plain M&A-activity control.

This is a near-identical restatement of the archived RND_EXPENSE_EXPLAINS_WEDGE — since xad is missing for the large majority of firms and is COALESCEd to zero, both legs are numerically unchanged for most of the sample, making this a cosmetic variant rather than a substantively different intangible channel.

The legs are individually familiar (lagged R&D stock, Sloan accruals), but the within-firm TS_RANK accrual-state normalization is a genuinely different conditioning device from the archived level/delta/MA wedge variants and is internally consistent with the stated positive sign, so it is worth one test despite being incremental.

It mechanically bolts the archived ACQUIRED_INTAN leg onto the archived INTAN_ACCRUAL_MEASURE_DISAGREE leg that already tested null (t=0.92 with the wrong sign), and the "disagreement" measure is economically misspecified because ib−oancf includes the depreciation add-back while the balance-sheet leg does not, so its absolute difference largely proxies depreciation intensity rather than non-articulation.

COALESCE(txp,0) converts widespread missing tax-payable data into a constant zero series whose 5-period VOL is exactly zero, creating a huge mass of tied ranks that will dominate the triple product, and the remaining two legs are the already-tested R&D-intensity × cash-wedge pair.

For the majority of firms xad is missing and COALESCEd to zero, so TS_RANK of a constant-zero series is degenerate and the composite effectively collapses to the cash-verification leg (a known cash-based profitability/accruals effect) over an artificially inflated coverage universe.

This is a recombination of already-evaluated components — the gdwl/(at+|ceq|) burden scaling from GOODWILL_BURDEN and the sign-flipped MA(3) R&D-adjusted wedge from ORGANIC_INTAN_CASH_DOMINANCE — and the wedge leg is the dominant, previously documented driver, so the incremental content of the intangible-burden leg is minimal.

This is essentially RND_EXPENSE_EXPLAINS_WEDGE / RND_ACCRUAL_NOISE_SHARE re-expressed over a 3-year window with the same bounded signed-wedge denominator, so it is a horizon-cosmetic variant of two already-tested archive signals rather than a new mechanism.

Replacing the static industry-adjusted margin level in RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED with a margin trend is a defensible economic change (pricing-power expansion rather than pricing-power level), but multiplying a strictly positive R&D intensity by a signed trend makes the first leg non-monotonic in R&D intensity and blurs which characteristic is actually being sorted on.

The obsolescence/failed-product-cycle channel for R&D-intensive firms is genuinely distinct from the archive's earnings-cash-wedge family, the invch sign convention is handled correctly, and the hypothesis matches the expression's direction — though the triple rank product will dilute the interaction and invch coverage should be checked.

This is the third pass at the identical acquired-intangible × working-capital-accrual pair (level in generation 2, trend in generation 4, now own-history TS_RANK), a purely cosmetic second-leg substitution on an already-strong archive signal rather than a substantively different idea.

It recombines already-tested pieces — the lagged R&D backlog leg from LAGGED_RND_CASH_REALIZATION/RND_BACKLOG_LOW_ACCRUAL_STATE, the MA wedge leg from ORGANIC_INTAN_CASH_DOMINANCE, and the wedge-volatility stability idea from PERSISTENT_RND_STABLE_ACCRUALS — into a fourth backlog variant with little incremental economic content.

Substituting receivable cash absorption for margin deterioration in the GOODWILL_MARGIN_CASH_SHORTFALL template is a real, if modest, mechanism change (revenue collection quality rather than pricing power), the recch sign is used correctly, but the R&D adjustment in the cash-shortfall leg is economically extraneous for goodwill-heavy acquirers and should be dropped or justified.

This is a mechanical merge of two archived signals (RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED's R&D×industry-adjusted-margin leg and RND_EXPENSE_EXPLAINS_WEDGE's bounded wedge-share leg) with no new economic content, so its incremental information over already-tested variants is minimal.

The economics (payables-financed operating cash flow contaminating R&D cash verification) were already tested in RND_CASH_AFTER_PAYABLES, and this merely converts the apalch adjustment from a subtraction into a separate multiplicative rank leg on the same template used by GOODWILL_RECEIVABLE_CASH_SHORTFALL.

Sign conventions are handled correctly (NEG(invch) = inventory build, positive recch = receivable collection) and the opposite-sign pairing of the two working-capital legs is a genuinely different configuration from the archived INTAN_DEMAND_WORKCAP_CASH_RELEASE and the sign-contradicted RND_INVENTORY_OBSOLESCENCE_TRAP, though it does bet against the well-known inventory-growth anomaly and should be interpreted cautiously if it works.

Direct rediscovery of CAPITALIZED_RND_SUBSTITUTION_ACCRUAL — the first leg is character-for-character identical and the second differs only by adding xrd inside the same accrual wedge, a cosmetic variant of an already-successful archived signal.

Essentially identical to the archived GOODWILL_RECEIVABLE_CASH_SHORTFALL (same gdwl/at and NEG(recch) legs; the wedge leg differs only by omitting the xrd add-back), making it a rediscovery rather than a new hypothesis.

The under-amortization-plus-accrual-mask economics were already captured by RECOGNIZED_INTAN_UNDERCHARGE_ACCRUAL (which differenced the same dpc and accrual terms), and recasting the difference as a three-way rank product is a cosmetic restructuring that additionally risks the dpc leg simply proxying for asset-light industry membership.

This is an incremental extension of the archived RND_CASH_AFTER_PAYABLES (same numerator, just also subtracting recch and invch), and the archive already shows that stripping working-capital components from the R&D cash wedge weakens rather than strengthens it (0.036/t=2.69 vs. 0.065/t=4.13 for the unadjusted wedge), so it is a cosmetic variant with a negative prior.

The expression is just the archived RND_INVENTORY_OBSOLESCENCE_TRAP with the margin-trend leg replaced by the receivables leg already used (with opposite sign) in RND_INVENTORY_BUILD_CASH_COLLECTION, and both parents produced the wrong-signed evidence for a negative expectation, so this is a low-content leg reshuffle rather than a new mechanism.

This is a direct clone of the archived GOODWILL_MOAT_ROLLOVER_ACCRUAL_MASK with the single substitution of xrd/sale for gdwl/at, and the R&D-intensity × margin-trend × accrual-wedge combination is already spanned by RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED and RND_MARGIN_INVENTORY_INFLATION.

It bolts an already-used margin-deterioration leg onto the archived GOODWILL_GROWTH_ACCRUAL_NONARTICULATION (level instead of delta goodwill), and that parent's evidence was internally contradictory (fmb −2.89 but ls_alpha +0.031/t=+2.52), so the negative expected sign is not supported for the non-directional ABS non-articulation leg being reused here.

Economically coherent and internally consistent, but it is essentially CAPITALIZED_INTAN_PRODUCTIVITY_TRAP with two operator swaps (intan level for delta, TS_RANK for TREND) — a cosmetic reparameterization of an archived signal rather than a substantively different mechanism.

The tax-accrual-magnitude × cash-flow-decay conditioning on R&D intensity is a genuinely different combination from the archived txp-level and txach-share variants and is directionally consistent, though the ABS(txach) leg is non-directional and risks proxying for scale or volatility rather than accounting opacity.

This is a mechanical splice of two already-archived signals — RND_BACKLOG_LOW_ACCRUAL_STATE (identical first leg and identical TS_RANK accrual leg) and RND_CASH_RESERVE_ACCRUAL_CLEAN (the che/at + SUMRANK construction) — so it adds no new economic content beyond bolting an existing cash-reserve rank onto an existing backlog-accrual signal.

It is essentially the sign-reversed second leg of the archived RND_ACCEL_CASH_FUNDED (and a close cousin of RND_CUT_ACCRUAL_INFLATION), so it tests the same accel-times-cash-verification interaction already shown to give a positive FMB slope with a negative long-short alpha, and the rank-product form makes the short leg a mixture of "decelerating R&D" and "well-verified cash," muddying the stated glamour mechanism.

The organic-R&D-minus-goodwill leg is verbatim from ORGANIC_INTAN_CASH_DOMINANCE and the WC-accrual leg is verbatim from ORGANIC_RND_WC_ACCRUAL_RECOVERY, with the only change being the addition of the che/at SUMRANK borrowed from RND_CASH_RESERVE_ACCRUAL_CLEAN — a cosmetic recombination of three already-evaluated components rather than a new mechanism.

This is INTAN_TAX_ACCRUAL_SHARE_TRAP with intan swapped for gdwl and the normalized tax-accrual share replaced by a raw, unwinsorized txach/at, i.e. an intangible-leg substitution plus a noisier second leg rather than a substantively different hypothesis, and the triple rank product will concentrate the extremes in a small, unstable subsample.

The "under-amortization relative to intangible base" leg is a genuinely distinct earnings-quality channel from the ib−oancf wedge used throughout the archive and its pairing with deteriorating OCF is coherent with the negative expected sign, though it overlaps RECOGNIZED_INTAN_UNDERCHARGE_ACCRUAL and INTAN_IMPAIRMENT_ACCRUAL_MASK and low dpc is partly a capital-intensity/industry proxy that should be checked as a confound.

It is RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED with the persistent cash-wedge leg swapped for a single-period recch term — a weaker, noisier proxy that the archive already showed to be near-uninformative in RND_INVENTORY_BUILD_CASH_COLLECTION — and receivable cash release is as often a symptom of decelerating sales as of high-quality collection, so the "moat validation" story is not cleanly identified.
